subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: (R)PER.VT.U.FUND.-----MT.INFO.
description: Diagram opening MP(II)-6 — the section on State Department use of creative music as 'an accelerated political factor — and tool — since the middle forties.' This diagram pairs with the v2-p487 (PER.PHY.U.FUND × SPT.DYM) crossing on the preceding page; where p487 diagrammed the periodic-physical-universe-fundament meeting spectacle-dynamism, this one diagrams the *vibrational* version of the same fundament meeting meta-information: (R)PER-VT-U-FUND (the reality of periodic vibrational-universe fundament — a region's vibrational ground as actually working) is crossed with MT-INFO (meta-information — the information *about* the information that State-Department transfer-cycles produce). PER-VT-U-FUND sits centrally with the subject-arrow; T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) rises above and STF (structural-formal) sits at the upper-right as the partner-side's upper output. SPT-DYM (spectacle dynamism — picking up the prior diagram's partner-axis) anchors the left, with IST-F (isolated focus) between SPT-DYM and PER-VT-U-FUND and MOT-DY (motion dynamics) at the lower-left as subject-side outputs. MT-INFO sits at the right as partner-axis; UNF-PI (unified physical-information) hangs on the right margin as partner-side output. SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) hangs centrally below as the bridging-axis hub with LK-IMP (linkage implication, written 'lk.inp.') as the bridging terminus. Structural argument: when periodic-vibrational-universe-fundament is crossed with meta-information, the upper diagonal T-C-IMP → STF → MT-INFO is the State Department's *meta-information route* — temporal-continuity-implication routes through structural-formal into the partner-axis. The left-side chain SPT-DYM → IST-F → MOT-DY is the carry-over from the prior diagram's spectacle-dynamism — the State Department's spectacle keeps producing isolated-focus motion-dynamics on the subject side. The central diagonal PER-VT-U-FUND → SOC-RT-DY → LK-IMP is the *vibrational-fundament's linkage route* — the form's actual vibrational ground reaches linkage-implication only through social-reality-dynamics. MT-INFO → UNF-PI is what the partner-side produces alone: unified-physical-information, the State Department's working output that converts a region's creativity into political tool. The crossing makes clear why the State Department succeeded: the partner-axis only needed the upper diagonal to produce its political tool, while the subject's vibrational ground had to hold both the spectacle-leftover and the central LK-IMP diagonal simultaneously.
